most_likely_actual_diagnosis_free_text: Severe Plasmodium falciparum malaria (cerebral malaria with severe anemia, thrombocytopenia, AKI, jaundice and hyperlactatemia) in a non-immune child returning from DRC
one_line_reason: Febrile child 2 weeks after returning from DRC without chemoprophylaxis, with anemia, profound thrombocytopenia, AKI, hyperbilirubinemia, lactic acidosis and altered mentation, fits severe falciparum malaria; vomiting and diarrhea are common in pediatric malaria and do not favor HUS given the high fever, jaundice and travel history.
